args.body:
File: src/config.ts

Ensure that configuration values expected to be integers (such as TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES parsed via int()) validate the entire string and reject duration suffixes like '12h' instead of silently parsing them via Number.parseInt().

label: bug
file: src/config.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The int() helper in src/config.ts parses environment variables with Number.parseInt without validating the whole string, allowing values with trailing characters like '12h' to be accepted as 12 instead of failing to start.

Parse Accept-Language header weights (q-values) correctly in pickLocale so that languages with higher quality factors are prioritized over those appearing earlier in the header with lower weights.

pickLocale currently ignores q-values when parsing Accept-Language headers and selects languages strictly by position rather than weight.
